summary.zh: 在受控目录内读写、搜索和整理文件，是本地项目协作最常用的基础服务器。
summary.en: Read, write, search, and organize files inside allowed directories — the workhorse local server.

hint.zh: 服务器只能访问这个目录及其子目录；需要更多目录时可在配置里追加参数。
hint.en: The server can only reach this directory and everything below it; add more paths in the config if needed.

detail.zh: 需要 Node.js 24 或更高版本

notes.zh: 只会访问命令行传入的目录；该服务器能修改文件，请授予尽量窄的目录。
notes.en: Only the directories passed on the command line are reachable. It can modify files, so grant the narrowest directory that works.

summary.zh: 查看状态、差异、日志和分支，并在本地仓库中提交改动。
summary.en: Inspect status, diffs, logs, and branches, and commit changes in a local repository.

hint.zh: 本地仓库路径，服务器会被限制在这个仓库内。
hint.en: Path to a local repository; the server is confined to this repository.

detail.zh: 需要已安装 uv（uvx 会自动准备 Python 环境）
detail.en: Requires uv installed (uvx provisions Python automatically)

notes.zh: 官方 Python 实现，通过 uvx 运行；--repository 是它唯一的隔离手段，处理不可信内容时务必设置。
notes.en: Official Python implementation run through uvx; --repository is its only confinement, so set it whenever prompts or content are untrusted.

summary.zh: 抓取网页并转换成适合模型阅读的 Markdown，省去手工复制正文。
summary.en: Fetch a web page and convert it to model-friendly Markdown instead of copying text by hand.

detail.zh: 需要已安装 uv（uvx 会自动准备 Python 环境）
detail.en: Requires uv installed (uvx provisions Python automatically)

detail.zh: 需要访问外网

notes.zh: 默认拒绝私有、回环等非公网地址；需要抓取内网页面时加 --allow-private-ips。Windows 下保留 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 可避免编码超时。
notes.en: Refuses private, loopback, and other non-public addresses by default; add --allow-private-ips to fetch intranet pages. Keeping PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 on Windows avoids encoding-related timeouts.

summary.zh: 用本地知识图谱跨会话记住实体、关系和观察，让助手越用越了解你的项目。
summary.en: Persist entities, relations, and observations across sessions in a local knowledge graph.

hint.zh: 知识图谱保存为 JSONL 文件，建议放在固定目录，方便备份和跨客户端共享。
hint.en: The graph is stored as a JSONL file; keep it in a stable location so it is easy to back up and share across clients.

detail.zh: 需要 Node.js 24 或更高版本

notes.zh: 不设置 MEMORY_FILE_PATH 时默认写到服务器目录下的 memory.jsonl；多个客户端共用一个文件时靠文件锁串行写入。
notes.en: Without MEMORY_FILE_PATH it writes memory.jsonl next to the server; sharing one file between clients serializes writes with a lock file.

summary.zh: 把复杂问题拆成可修订、可分支的思考步骤，适合规划和排障。
summary.en: Break a complex problem into revisable, branchable reasoning steps for planning and debugging.

detail.zh: 需要 Node.js 24 或更高版本

summary.zh: 查询当前时间，并在 IANA 时区之间做换算，避免模型算错时差。
summary.en: Get the current time and convert between IANA time zones so the model stops guessing offsets.

detail.zh: 需要已安装 uv（uvx 会自动准备 Python 环境）
detail.en: Requires uv installed (uvx provisions Python automatically)

notes.zh: 默认使用系统时区，可用 --local-timezone 覆盖；Docker 方式需要设置 LOCAL_TIMEZONE。
notes.en: Uses the system time zone by default; override with --local-timezone (the Docker image needs LOCAL_TIMEZONE).

summary.zh: 官方参考/测试服务器，同时提供工具、资源和提示，适合验证客户端的 MCP 支持程度。
summary.en: The official reference/test server with tools, resources, and prompts for exercising a client's MCP support.

detail.zh: 需要 Node.js 24 或更高版本

notes.zh: 仅用于试用和调试，不建议作为日常工具集；加 streamableHttp 子命令可启动 HTTP 模式。
notes.en: For experimentation and debugging only, not a daily toolset; the streamableHttp subcommand starts an HTTP mode.

summary.zh: 按库名和版本拉取最新的官方文档与代码示例，减少过时 API 造成的幻觉。
summary.en: Pull current, version-specific library docs and code examples to avoid stale-API hallucinations.

detail.zh: 需要访问 context7.com

notes.zh: 无需密钥即可使用；在 context7.com 获取免费 API Key 后，用 Authorization: Bearer <key> 请求头可提高速率限制。
notes.en: Works without a key; a free API key from context7.com sent as the Authorization: Bearer <key> header raises rate limits.

summary.zh: 免费读取公开 GitHub 仓库的 DeepWiki 文档结构，并基于仓库内容回答问题。
summary.en: Read DeepWiki documentation for public GitHub repositories and ask repository-grounded questions.

detail.zh: 需要访问 deepwiki.com

notes.zh: 只覆盖公开仓库，无需认证；私有仓库需要 Devin 账号和 Devin MCP。
notes.en: Public repositories only and no authentication; private repositories need a Devin account and the Devin MCP server.

summary.zh: 通过可访问性快照驱动真实浏览器：导航、点击、填表、截图和网络检查。
summary.en: Drive a real browser through accessibility snapshots: navigate, click, fill, screenshot, and inspect network traffic.

detail.zh: 需要 Node.js 18 或更高版本
浏览外部页面时需要外网
detail.en: Outbound network is needed to browse external pages

notes.zh: 默认有头模式启动；加 --headless 可无头运行，用 --browser chrome/firefox/webkit 切换内核。
notes.en: Starts headed by default; add --headless for headless runs and --browser chrome/firefox/webkit to pick an engine.

summary.zh: 用 Chrome DevTools 做性能追踪、网络与控制台调试，以及可靠的页面自动化。
summary.en: Performance traces, network and console debugging, and reliable automation via Chrome DevTools.

detail.en: Requires a Node.js LTS release (20.19+, 22.12+, or 23+)

notes.zh: 需要本机安装稳定版 Chrome；使用性能工具时可能把 trace URL 发给 Google CrUX，可用 --no-performance-crux 关闭。
notes.en: Needs a locally installed stable Chrome; performance tools may send trace URLs to Google CrUX, which --no-performance-crux disables.

summary.zh: GitHub 官方远程服务器：读写仓库、Issue、PR、Actions 并进行代码搜索。
summary.en: GitHub's hosted server for repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, and code search.

hint.zh: 在 GitHub Settings → Developer settings 创建，按需勾选 repo、read:org 等最小权限。
hint.en: Create it under GitHub Settings → Developer settings and grant only the scopes you need (repo, read:org, …).

detail.zh: 需要一个 GitHub PAT
需要访问 api.githubcopilot.com

notes.zh: 远程端点也支持 OAuth；本插件按请求头注入 PAT，因此这里用令牌方式接入。令牌只会保存在本机 Host。
notes.en: The remote endpoint also supports OAuth; this plugin injects a PAT header, so the token flow is used here. The token stays on the local Host.

summary.zh: 连接 Notion 工作区，搜索页面、读取内容并更新数据库。
summary.en: Connect a Notion workspace to search pages, read content, and update databases.

detail.zh: 首次连接在浏览器中完成 Notion OAuth 授权
detail.en: First connection completes Notion OAuth in the browser

detail.zh: 需要访问 mcp.notion.com

notes.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 授权；旧客户端仍可用 /sse 端点，但推荐 Streamable HTTP。
notes.en: Authorizes with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE; the /sse endpoint remains for older clients, but Streamable HTTP is recommended.

summary.zh: 检索错误、分析性能并跟进 Issue，把线上问题直接带进编码上下文。
summary.en: Search errors, analyze performance, and triage issues right from your coding context.

detail.zh: 首次连接在浏览器中完成 Sentry OAuth 授权
detail.en: First connection completes Sentry OAuth in the browser

detail.zh: 需要访问 mcp.sentry.dev

notes.zh: 所有连接都走 OAuth；可在 URL 后接 /<org>/<project> 把工具限定到某个组织或项目。
notes.en: All connections use OAuth; append /<org>/<project> to the URL to scope tools to one organization or project.

summary.zh: 在 Linear 中查找、创建和更新 Issue、项目与文档。
summary.en: Find, create, and update issues, projects, and documents in Linear.

hint.zh: 在 Linear Settings → Security & access → Personal API keys 创建；只读场景可用只读 key。
hint.en: Create one under Linear Settings → Security & access → Personal API keys; use a read-only key for read-only work.

detail.zh: 需要一个 Linear API Key
需要访问 mcp.linear.app

notes.zh: 也支持 OAuth；本插件用 Authorization: Bearer <API Key> 接入。只读场景可改用 https://mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly。
notes.en: OAuth is also supported; this plugin connects with Authorization: Bearer <API key>. For read-only access use https://mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly.

summary.zh: 通过 DBHub 连接 PostgreSQL，执行 SQL、浏览 schema，并带只读与超时护栏。
summary.en: Connect to PostgreSQL through DBHub to run SQL and explore schemas, with read-only and timeout guardrails.

hint.zh: 包含账号密码的连接串，例如 postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/mydb；本地库可加 ?sslmode=disable。
hint.en: Connection string with credentials, e.g. postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/mydb; add ?sslmode=disable for a local server.

detail.zh: 需要 Node.js 22.5 或更高版本
需要数据库连接串（含凭据）
detail.en: Needs a database connection string with credentials

notes.zh: 官方参考实现 server-postgres 已归档；DBHub 是维护中的多数据库替代，同时支持 PostgreSQL、SQLite 等。
notes.en: The official reference server-postgres is archived; DBHub is a maintained multi-database replacement that also covers SQLite.

summary.zh: 用 DBHub 打开本地 SQLite 文件，执行 SQL 并查看表、索引等结构。
summary.en: Open a local SQLite file with DBHub to run SQL and inspect tables, indexes, and other schema objects.

hint.zh: 指向数据库文件的 DSN，格式为 sqlite:///绝对路径，例如 sqlite:///C:/Users/me/data/app.db。
hint.en: DSN pointing at the database file, in the form sqlite:///absolute/path, e.g. sqlite:///C:/Users/me/data/app.db.

detail.zh: 需要 Node.js 22.5 或更高版本

notes.zh: 官方参考实现 server-sqlite 已归档；DBHub 通过内置的 node:sqlite 访问 SQLite 文件。
notes.en: The official reference server-sqlite is archived; DBHub reaches SQLite files through the built-in node:sqlite module.

summary.zh: 通过 Brave Search API 做网页、新闻、图片、视频和本地搜索。
summary.en: Web, news, image, video, and local search backed by the Brave Search API.

hint.zh: 在 Brave Search API 控制台申请；免费套餐有调用额度限制。
hint.en: Create one in the Brave Search API dashboard; free plans are rate limited.

detail.zh: 需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本
需要 Brave Search API Key
detail.en: Needs a Brave Search API key

notes.zh: 官方参考 Brave Search 服务器已归档，这是 Brave 官方维护的替代实现；本地搜索等能力可能需要 Pro 套餐。
notes.en: Replaces the archived reference Brave Search server with Brave's officially maintained implementation; local search may require a Pro plan.

summary.zh: 查询 Terraform Registry 的 provider/module 文档，也可连接 HCP Terraform 私有注册表。
summary.en: Look up Terraform Registry provider and module docs, optionally against an HCP Terraform private registry.

detail.zh: 需要 Docker Engine 20.10.21+ 或 Docker Desktop 4.14+，且守护进程已启动
detail.en: Needs Docker Engine 20.10.21+ or Docker Desktop 4.14+ with the daemon running

detail.zh: 查询 Registry 需要外网
detail.en: Querying the registry needs outbound network

notes.zh: 公开 Registry 无需 Token；连接 HCP Terraform 或 Terraform Enterprise 时在环境中设置 TFE_TOKEN（以及 TFE_ADDRESS）。官方也提供预编译二进制。
notes.en: The public registry needs no token; set TFE_TOKEN (and TFE_ADDRESS) in the environment for HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise. A prebuilt binary is also available.
